steps: Select a deterministic scenario and inspect observations.
Configure expiry, legs and lots; preview exact risk and costs.
Confirm a paper trade, inspect risk, close and review the journal.
Exercise rejection/disconnection; inspect illustrative research and governance.
Switch completed candle timeframe and inspect pointer/keyboard crosshair.
Zoom and pan; toggle volume, EMA9 and session VWAP.
Create and remove price/trend annotations with pointer or native fields.
Inspect evidence without altering paper state or broker isolation.

performance_budgets.method: Five local navigation samples in pinned Chromium and fixed synthetic fixture.

title: AlgoOptionX first interactive demo with chart tools

user_goals.description: Inspect synthetic evidence, construct a defined-risk strategy and complete a paper lifecycle.
Inspect and annotate a synthetic chart through pointer and keyboard without authorizing execution.
